newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close steady on thin markets.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close steady on thin markets.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed steady on Friday with sentiment still affected by Iraq's purchases of French wheat.
"The effect of the Iraqi business is still in the market, and with the cash market at a virtual standstill people are turning to the futures for cover," said a trader.
Wheat closed 0.25 to 0.40 stg up with most traded May 0.40 stg higher after a last trade of 101.00 stg.
May traded 257 lots out of a total of 419 lots.
Barley finished 0.25 stg higher after most traded Jan closed unchanged with a last trade of 94 stg.
Jan traded 48 lots out of the total of 63 lots.
The Amsterdam milling wheat futures contract has been suspended indefinitely due to low participation, the Amsterdam Agricultural Futures Exchange said.
